title: $100 a month into Amazon since 2008 is now worth this
caption:
$100 every month into Amazon since 2008.
Today that would be worth about {dca:AMZN:2008-01-02} (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: Could you put away $100 a month? 👇
sources: Amazon price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time

scenes.say: One hundred dollars a month, into Amazon, starting in 2008.
Back then, Amazon was selling online in a recession.

clip.text: Amazon: selling online in a recession

scenes.say: Today, those monthly payments would be worth about {dca:AMZN:2008-01-02}.
Small, boring, every month. That's how wealth is built.
